# upsnap_group (Data Source)

Look up a device group by ID or by its unique name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "upsnap_group" "office" {
  name = "Office"
}

output "office_device_ids" {
  value = data.upsnap_group.office.device_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Record ID. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Group name. Fails when no group or more than one group has this name.

### Read-Only

- `device_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the devices in the group that the credentials can read.
